conditions: Standing caps, not mission RNG, make the Bond set take several days.
Manifold Bond is the central upgrade: Arc Coil applies every damage type on the companion weapon, regardless of status chance or weighting.
Reinforced Bond cannot activate on Diriga because its base shields are too low.
bonuses: For priming, use a companion weapon with many distinct damage types; do not prioritize raw damage.
Arc Coil can trigger Archon Stretch, while Synth Deconstruct plus Equilibrium is a strong separate energy engine.
Place Calculated Shot last or remove it: Arc Coil blocks it from firing and avoids drawing sentinel fire.

disclosures.title: the acquisition is easy; the build is not
disclosures.body: Diriga itself is a predictable Market blueprint plus a one-day Foundry timer. The reason to delay judgment until Manifold Bond is installed is that the community's primer build depends on Arc Coil spreading the weapon's full palette of damage types. The Bond vendors need Ostron Trusted and Solaris United Doer, so the standing path—not the sentinel—is the multi-day portion.

disclosures.title: uptime and limitations
disclosures.body: Sentinels self-revive after incapacitation but cannot be manually revived; Momentous Bond and Primed Regen help close that downtime. Diriga cannot use Loyal or Resourceful Retriever, so it gives up beast-only loot doubling. Avoid Heat on the companion weapon if your own build relies on Heat damage-over-time inheritance, because a companion Heat proc can take priority.
